sentiment.summary: Market fear (31/100) presents contrarian opportunity, but congressional activity is stale and mixed with no recent conviction signals; neutral to slightly bearish setup.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (325.76) combined with critical earnings binary event in 7 days creates severe near-term risk for FCX despite normal yield curve.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with supertrend bullish and Ichimoku above cloud provides solid technical structure, and extreme VIX fear (31/100) creates contrarian opportunity for risk-tolerant traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical earnings binary event within 7 days combined with VIX crisis regime (325.76), overbought RSI_21, volume divergence (OBV not rising with price), and zero fundamental conviction make this a high-risk entry with asymmetric downside.
